question: Famous dance personality Rajarshi Bhagya Chandra is also known as:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ningthou Ching-Thang Khomba**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__

• **Ningthou Ching-Thang Khomba**, also known as Rajarshi Bhagya Chandra, was a king of Manipur in the 18th century.

• He is renowned for his contributions to the promotion and development of the classical dance form known as Manipuri.

• Under his reign, the Ras Lila dance form was introduced, which is a significant aspect of Manipuri dance.

• He is revered for his deep devotion to Lord Krishna and his efforts to incorporate the Vaishnavite traditions into Manipuri culture.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Manipuri Dance**

• Manipuri dance is one of the major Indian classical dance forms and is native to the state of Manipur.

• It is known for its graceful and fluid movements, often depicting the themes of love and devotion, particularly the divine love of Radha and Krishna.

• The dance form incorporates both solo and group performances, and the costumes are elaborate and colorful, often featuring a distinctive cylindrical skirt for women.

• **Ras Lila**

• Ras Lila is a dance drama that portrays the divine love story of Radha and Krishna and their playful activities with the Gopis (milkmaids) of Vrindavan.

• This dance form is an integral part of the Vaishnavite traditions in Manipur and is performed during various festivals and religious occasions.

• The dance is characterized by its devotional fervor, intricate footwork, and expressive hand gestures, combined with the enchanting music and singing that accompany the performance.

• **Vaishnavism in Manipur**

• Vaishnavism, the worship of Lord Vishnu and his avatars, particularly Krishna, was introduced in Manipur during the reign of King Pamheiba in the early 18th century.

• Rajarshi Bhagya Chandra played a pivotal role in further establishing and promoting Vaishnavite traditions in the region.

• The cultural and religious landscape of Manipur was significantly influenced by these traditions, leading to the development of various art forms, including Manipuri dance.
